newsitem.title: THAILAND: Export value of Jan-Sept Thai vehicles, parts down.
newsitem.headline: Export value of Jan-Sept Thai vehicles, parts down.

text.p: The value of Thai exports of assembled vehicles and parts slipped 6.63 percent in the first nine months to 7.49 billion baht ($300 million) from 8.03 billion the same period last year, an industry group said on Thursday.

The export value of cars and car parts during January-September fell 7.14 percent to 2.48 billion baht from 2.67 billion in the same period a year ago, the Thai Automobile Industry Association said in a statement.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle parts in the period was down 6.37 percent to 5.02 billion baht from 5.36 billion over the first nine months of 1995, the association said.
The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand during January-September period rose 6.83 percent to 410,028 from 383,830 in the same period a year ago, it said.
